metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to compare NDVI (a greenness metric) at Windhoek, Namibia on two dates: - Date 1: January 29, 2020 - Date 2: February 7, 2021 I'll use Sentinel-2 data, which has good temporal coverage. Windhoek is at approximately -22.56°S, 17.08°E. 2. Masking strategy: I should mask clouds using the SCL (Scene Classification) band to get valid vegetation pixels. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - If collection is empty for either date → C1 - If pixel count is 0 after cloud masking → C2 - If NDVI values are None/NaN or out of valid range (-1 to 1) → C3 - If NDVI_2021 > NDVI_2020 → A (greener) - Otherwise → B (not greener) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Windhoek geometry const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.08, -22.56]); const buffer = windhoek.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer for region // 2. Function to mask clouds using SCL band function maskClouds(img) { const scl = img.select('SCL'); const cloud = scl.eq(3).or(scl.eq(8)).or(scl.eq(9)); // Cloud/cirrus classes return img.updateMask(cloud.not()); } // 3. Get Sentinel-2 data for both dates const col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate('2020-01-25', '2020-02-02') .map(maskClouds) .select(['B4', 'B8']); // Red, NIR for NDVI const col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate('2021-02-04', '2021-02-10') .map(maskClouds) .select(['B4', 'B8']); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); print(`2020-01-29 Images: ${size2020}`); print(`2021-02-07 Images: ${size2021}`); // Check for empty collections if (size2020 === 0 || size2021 === 0) { print(`No data found for one or both dates.`); print(`C1`); return; } // 4. Calculate median NDVI for each date const img2020 = col2020.median(); const img2021 = col2021.median(); // Calculate NDVI: (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) const ndvi2020 = img2020.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const ndvi2021 = img2021.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // 5. Calculate valid pixel count and NDVI values const stats2020 = ndvi2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ndvi_val_2020 = stats2020.NDVI_mean; const ndvi_val_2021 = stats2021.NDVI_mean; const count_2020 = stats2020.NDVI_count; const count_2021 = stats2021.NDVI_count; print(`2020-01-29: NDVI=${ndvi_val_2020?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count_2020}`); print(`2021-02-07: NDVI=${ndvi_val_2021?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count_2021}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count_2020 === 0 || count_2021 === 0) { print(`No valid pixels after masking.`); print(`C2`); return; } // Check for valid NDVI values if (ndvi_val_2020 === null || ndvi_val_2020 === undefined || ndvi_val_2021 === null || ndvi_val_2021 === undefined || isNaN(ndvi_val_2020) || isNaN(ndvi_val_2021) || ndvi_val_2020 < -1 || ndvi_val_2020 > 1 || ndvi_val_2021 < -1 || ndvi_val_2021 > 1) { print(`Invalid NDVI calculation.`); print(`C3`); return; } // 6. Compare NDVI values print(`NDVI Change: ${(ndvi_val_2021 - ndvi_val_2020).toFixed(3)}`); if (ndvi_val_2021 > ndvi_val_2020) { print(`A`); } else { print(`B`); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
